purpose: Teach: 脚光/全盛期/迷走/イジメ/争奪/自尊心/趨勢/再犯

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、犯人が脚光を浴びた事を警察、把握されてますね
lines.en: I imagine the police are aware that the suspect in this case has gotten a lot of attention.
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful opening. Slight upward lilt on the observation itself—not quite a question, but genuinely exploring the thought. Quiet intellectual engagement, no urgency. Soft trailing-off into acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪が全盛期に達する前に未然防止します
lines.en: We intervene before crimes escalate to their peak. Prevention is the focus.
lines.style: Direct, professional delivery. Clipped on the opening clause. Steady, confident tone without stiffness. The certainty of someone stating policy, not justifying it. Even pace, grounded.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、捜査が迷走することのないよう警察、慎重ですね
lines.en: I'd say the police are being careful to make sure the investigation doesn't go off track.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before the main clause. Gentle, respectful framing—not challenging, observing. Mid-range register. Soft emphasis on 'careful.' Light trailing quality, like he's checking his own reading of the situation.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、学校でのイジメ事案に厳しく対応します
lines.en: We take bullying cases at school with complete seriousness. That's non-negotiable.
lines.style: Firmer tone. Clear emphasis on the severity. Still measured, not aggressive—the quiet weight of institutional responsibility. Crisp consonants on 'seriousness.' Closed with finality, no softness.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、不動産の争奪戦を警察、注視されてますね
lines.en: I notice the police are watching this case closely—there's property and interests at stake here.
lines.style: Slow, deliberate opening. Sensing something beneath the surface. Thoughtful pause mid-sentence before naming the conflict. Intellectual, not sensational. Quiet intensity. Soft landing on the observation.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、被害者の自尊心を傷つけない対応を徹底します
lines.en: We're committed to handling this in a way that doesn't damage the victim's dignity. That's paramount.
lines.style: Steady, protective tone. Emphasis on 'dignity'—weighted with meaning. Professional but humane. Not defensive, simply stating what matters. Even pacing. Closed with quiet conviction.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、社会の趨勢を読みつつ警察、捜査されますね
lines.en: The police seem to be investigating thoughtfully—reading the social currents, not just reacting.
lines.style: Appreciative undertone. Measured pace. Slight wonder in the observation—recognizing something nuanced. Soft emphasis on the complexity of approach. Open-ended quality, like he's still processing it.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、再犯防止の活動を続けます
lines.en: Our work continues to focus on preventing these situations from happening again.
lines.style: Quiet resolve. Steady, forward-looking tone. No flourish, no exhaustion—just the continuation of commitment. Grounded and purposeful. Slight softness on the final clause, like an echo of that commitment.
